read_only: Use q_values+masked argmax, never exploration choose. Full learner(network,target,replay,Adam,private RNG,choices,cursor) fingerprint before/after each completed candidate case and final snapshot file hashes. RPC exposes no learning/commit method.
same_information: Every role uses identical generated R2 world/sensors/mask/guards and sidecar-v2/bridge. Selector-specific ACK/screening policies remain their algorithm behavior; no role-specific physics or external guard relaxation. Actor receives canonical body/target/history features only, no truth coordinates/reward/seed.
cache: Baseline cases cached independently of candidate weights, bound to protocol/source/role/seed/profile; candidate cases additionally bind snapshot and full immutable learner fingerprint. Checksummed completed reports return without new process/worlds. Corrupt receipts are errors, never silently rerun. All unavailability/assistance/timeout outcomes remain in denominators.
selection_discipline: Actual selection requires complete validation reports for every planned snapshot, same full reference population, unchanged R2/R3 gates and validation-only tie-break. Test/software reports rejected. Test requires a separate engineering review binding immutable selection and selected snapshot. No test access in this preflight.

tests.pure_gate_cases: Synthetic metric tables only verify original thresholds/best-reference comparison/ties. No training,validation or test scenes opened for gate tests.
tests.temporary_cleanup: Resolve navigation-evaluator-unit-* or navigation-evaluator-core-unit-* direct child of workspace/work before recursive cleanup; never retain synthetic checkpoint as project-trained model.
